title: AI providers
description: Manage external AI providers and BYOK credentials. Keys are encrypted at rest and never displayed in plain text.
addProviderDescription: Connect a new provider. The key is verified immediately, then stored encrypted.
nameAndModelRequired: Name and default model are required.
apiKeyRequired: An API key is required for this provider.
providerConnectedDescription: The credential was verified and stored encrypted.
couldNotVerify: Could not verify the credential. Check the key and endpoint.
couldNotSetDefault: Could not set the default provider.
credentialRotatedDescription: The old key is no longer usable.
insufficientPermissionsDescription: You need auditor or administrator access to view AI provider configuration.
noProvidersDescriptionAdmin: Add a provider to enable AI features with your own credentials.
noProvidersDescriptionViewer: Ask an administrator to configure an AI provider.
rotateDescription: Enter the new API key for {{provider}} — {{name}}. The previous key stops working immediately.
byokPoint1: API keys are verified on save, encrypted at rest, and only ever shown as a hashed reference (keyRef).
byokPoint2: Rotation invalidates the previous key immediately. Set a provider as default to route new AI tasks to it.
byokPoint3: Only administrators can add, rotate or remove credentials. Auditors and lawyers can view provider status.
